digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md + docs guidance; MCP server routing policy
propositions: Rebar tracker operations must route through the MCP server, with an explicit carve-out for local-code operations (testing, investigation, debugging, validation).
The MCP-required policy must be documented in AGENTS.md as an umbrella rule governing downstream guidance surfaces (docs/, templates/, .agents/rules/, packaged rebar explain guides, example skills).

Certified operations (plan-review and completion-verifier only per ADR 0049) route through MCP and are enforceable via trusted-env registration; code-review is a Gerrit LLM-Review vote, not an op-cert.
Guidance must describe certified-op enforcement as deferred/enableable (not live) and cite the mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md runbook.

docs/mcp-auth.md §7 must document the AWS deployment recipe using ADR-named config keys (http_tls_at_edge, auth_static_tokens_file, auth_strategies) and link to docs/mcp-client-setup.md for client configuration.
